rows.text: The Secretary-General laid on the Table on 22 April 1997 the Prime Minister's (H. D. Deve Gowda's) letter dated 11 April 1997 to the President tendering his own resignation and that of his Council of Ministers.

locator.line: 22.04.97, RESIGNATION OF COUNCIL OF MINISTERS, paper (1)

rows.text: The papers laid include the President's letter dated 12 April 1997 to Deve Gowda accepting his resignation and that of his colleagues.
The same letter of 12 April 1997 requests Deve Gowda to continue in office till alternative arrangements are made.
